scripts.build: npm run build -w @glide/core && npm run build -w glide && npm run build -w @glide/web
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @glide/core && npm run build -w glide
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run start -w @glide/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @glide/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w @glide/desktop && npm run start -w @glide/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w @glide/desktop && npm run dist -w @glide/desktop
